title: Bata Shoe Museum
content: TheBata Shoe Museumin Toronto explores just one theme: footwear.The exhibits take up four floors of the museum, with displays showing the history and cultural variation of shoes, sandals, slippers, boots, and even snowshoes.Two strengths of the displayed collection are the footwear of Native Americans and fashion shoes from 1920-1950.The Native American room has moveable benches, but sketchers might want to bring their own stools for the other rooms.I drew the sketches with:Caran D'Ache watercolor pencilsand aNiji Waterbrushin aMoleskine Watercolor Notebook.If you go, here's a tip: Pick up a "second person free" coupon, which appears in the tourist booklets.Wikipedia: Bata Shoe MuseumBata official site
